alternative_explanations: Any gain may come from quadratic feature expansion or collision luck rather than transferable predictive equivalence; raw and random matched controls isolate this.
The learned key may merely route support examples while the local ridge operator does all useful work; cross-family-only versus support-only is decisive.
confounds: Thresholds are frozen from development training-role worlds with seeds 1103/2207/3301 and cannot be altered after scoring.
The evaluator privately identifies families only for balanced metrics; candidate code receives no family labels, paths, native types, semantic channel names or test outputs.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate if any candidate receives a family label, source path, native type or semantic channel name.
Invalidate if normalization reads a holdout output or any value outside assigned slow-fit worlds.
Invalidate if a history, support or forecast window crosses a whole-world or DS08a cycle boundary.
Invalidate if shared, independent, cross-family-only or support-only changes learner source or hyperparameters.
Invalidate if masked loss is not averaged within world and equally across the three evaluator-private families.
Invalidate if acquisition, normalization, fit, adaptation, query, update, bytes, state or R1/R4/R16 cost is omitted.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, scoring-seed leakage, external model/API use or evaluator-integrity change.

falsification_criteria: Discard if the learned code fails the frozen future-equivalence, permutation, source-identity, bounded-state, local-update or v4 empty-bucket fixtures before scoring.
Discard if any family/K shared NRMSE advantage over raw-window, random-hash or persistence is <=0.03806855146519833.
Discard if any family/K shared_vs_independent_gain or cross_family_transfer_gain is <=0.03806855146519833.

Discard if worst-family accuracy trails persistence by more than 0.008823017208322348, stability is below 1.0, query work grows with K under the fixed cap, or a simpler implementable baseline dominates after full cost.

Invalidate on threshold hash mismatch, source/hyperparameter mismatch across roles, family/path/native-type/semantic-channel/test-output access, post-score tuning, external model/API, omitted cost, baseline/preflight failure or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: Discard this exact predictive-equivalence index without tuning, preserve all evidence, and redirect to a fundamentally different learned mechanism.
outcome_policy.null: Treat any mixed-sign, below-threshold or Pareto-dominated pattern as negative for this exact design and do not tune bits, moments, ridge, bucket cap or thresholds.
outcome_policy.positive: Authorize only unchanged three-seed adversarial replication of the exact five-bit code, features, target moments, bucket cap and local operator; do not mark promising or claim a scaling law.
